seed.title: Stripe webhook must include idempotency_key to prevent duplicate charges
seed.content: Without idempotency_key, webhook retries from Stripe will process the payment multiple times. Always set Idempotency-Key header in webhook handler responses.

seed.title: JWT tokens must use RS256 algorithm for multi-service environments
seed.content: HS256 uses a shared secret which leaks between services. RS256 uses asymmetric keys - only the auth service holds the private key, all services verify with the public key.

seed.title: Database connection pool max_size must be set to prevent OOM under load
